name: Medium Dark Blood Synchronizer
description: Built by Blood Raider engineers from combined Amarr and Minmatar synchronizers, this rig improves Energy Nosferatu, Energy Neutralizer and Energy Turret performance. However, the brute force combination that powers this synchronizer takes a significant toll on its capacitor recharge. It also integrates the pathways between Dark Blood technology. This unlocks even greater performance the more Dark Blood modules are installed. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The CPU drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Synchronization Rigging skill.
